What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

You will be responsible for:

• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor

• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

ABOUT ACE
 

ACE, founded in 1977, is an international engineering group, with more than 200 people and with operations in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. We combine engineering, consultancy, (prototype) machine building and product development, working with customers across a range of industrial sectors.
 

Our different activities and entities require a finance organisation that works effectively across borders, with consistent processes, reporting and controls. Further harmonising Finance across the group is therefore an important step in the continued development of ACE.
 

THE ROLE
 

As Head of Finance, you will have overall financial responsibility for ACE in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. You will define the financial processes, reporting principles and controls across the group and further align financial operations across the different countries.
 

You will shape the financial architecture of the group on reporting, accounting, tax, budgeting, cashflow management and business performance analysis.
 

You will take a hands-on approach, further embed the accounting processes within the ERP system and deliver timely and reliable financial visibility of the business to the Board and management of the group.
 

As a member of the Management Team, you will bring financial insight to operational and strategic decision-making in support of the growth of the group.
 

 
 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 

- Act as a strategic financial partner, providing clear insight on performance, growth initiatives
 

and value creation across the different countries and entities.
 

- Optimise working capital and cash discipline (invoicing, billing, cash conversion,
 

WIP/inventory).
 

- Enhance visibility into profitability by customer, project, service line, country and legal
 

entity.
 

- Lead, mentor and develop the finance teams, creating a high-performance culture focused
 

on accountability and continuous improvement.
 

- Strengthen and safeguard compliance, governance and risk management across the group.
 

You will directly manage the finance teams in Lummen (BE), Bruges (BE), Eindhoven (NL) and
 

Poznan (PL) and work directly with the branch manager in Porto (PT). You will report directly to the member of the Board at group level.
 

 
 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in finance, including experience with broad financial
 

responsibility.
 

- Experience working across multiple legal entities. International experience is an advantage.
 

- Broad financial expertise covering accounting, controlling, consolidation, budgeting,
 

forecasting and cash flow.
 

- Experience leading and developing finance professionals.
 

- Strong analytical skills combined with a hands-on approach and the willingness to take on
 

operational financial matters yourself.
 

- Experience structuring and improving financial processes in a multi-entity environment.
 

- Experience in an industrial, engineering or project-driven environment is preferred.
 

- Experience with ERP systems; knowledge of AFAS is an advantage.
 

- Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English.
 

 
 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE INTERESTING?
 

You will take on a broad financial mandate across four countries, with direct involvement in the management and decision-making of the group. The role gives you the opportunity to further shape the finance organisation, bring greater consistency across the different entities and have a visible impact on the further development of the group.
 

Interested? We look forward to your application.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

As an AP Accountant based in Merksem, you will play a key role in managing accounts payable processes within the industrial and manufacturing sector. This permanent position involves handling financial transactions and ensuring accuracy in the accounting and finance department.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Omschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level as a Die Cutting Machine Operator? We're looking for someone like you to join our dynamic team. You'll set up and operate cutting-edge machinery in a fast-paced environment, ensuring precision and quality in every product.

In this role, you'll start your day by setting up the die cutter based on order specifications. Your keen eye for detail will ensure everything is in its right place, from adjusting feeder plates to installing dies. You'll work across two shifts, maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency to meet production goals.

Ready to make your mark in an industry-leading company? Apply today and become part of a team that values precision, quality, and innovation.

• Minimum of 2 years experience as a Die Cutting Machine Operator

• Technical knowledge, gained through studies or practical experience

• Communicative knowledge of English

• Affinity with technology and attention to detail

• Willingness to work two shifts: 1st shift from Monday to Thursday, 5:15 to 13:15, and Friday, 5:00 to 13:00; 2nd shift from Monday to Thursday, 13:15 to 21:15, and Friday, 11:00 to 17:00
